series.name: PK technician YouTube title-level only (E6/F1/E5)
series.notes: PK-context YouTube titles (technoboy E6, E6/F1 inverter, E5 Shorts) — title-level only, no transcripts. Corroborates existence of codes in field use; meanings inherited from IE table with low confidence note.

title.ur: Non-inverter unit ki communication kharabi ka hal — video title

meaning.en: Video title claims an E6 communication fix for non-inverter Electrolux-style split.
meaning.ur: Video title mein non-inverter split ke liye E6 communication hal ka da'wa hai.

causes.en: Consistent with official IE E6 (indoor–outdoor signal wire) — not verified in video body.
causes.ur: Official IE E6 (indoor–outdoor signal wire) se milta hai — video ke matn mein is ki sakhiye nahi hui.

causes.en: Interconnect wiring issues are the usual field cause.
causes.ur: Field mein aam tor par interconnect wiring ki kharabi hoti hai.

solutions.en: Prefer official guidance: contact Authorised Service Center.
solutions.ur: Tarike se official guidance follow karein: Authorised Service Center se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle once and check the signal cable if safe to do so.
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein aur mehfooz ho to signal cable check karein.

notes.en: Title/description only — YouTube page fetch returned no transcript. Low confidence.
notes.ur: Sirf title/description mili — YouTube page se transcript nahi mila, is liye confidence low.

title.en: Inverter F1 sensor fix — video title
title.ur: Inverter F1 sensor ka hal — video title

meaning.en: Video title references F1 on an inverter Electrolux-style unit.
meaning.ur: Video title inverter unit par F1 ka zikr karta hai.

causes.en: Matches official IE F1: indoor ambient sensor open/short.
causes.ur: Official IE F1 se milta hai: indoor ambient sensor khula/short

causes.en: Sensor connector or thermistor failure typical in field.
causes.ur: Field mein aam tor par sensor connector ya thermistor ki kharabi hai.

solutions.en: Follow official IE F1 guidance (restart, then service).
solutions.ur: Official IE F1 guidance par amal karein — pehle restart, phir service.

solutions.en: Do not rely on video alone for repair steps.
solutions.ur: Marammat ke liye sirf video par yakeen na karein.

notes.ur: Sirf title ke level par hai.

title.ur: E5 overcurrent — Shorts video ka title

meaning.en: Short-form video title referencing Electrolux-style E5.
meaning.ur: Short form video title Electrolux jaise E5 ka zikr karta hai.

causes.en: Matches official IE E5: AC overcurrent protection.
causes.ur: Official IE E5 se milta hai: AC overcurrent ki protection

causes.en: Unstable supply is the common field cause in PK.
causes.ur: Pakistan mein aam tor par supply ka unstable hona hai.

solutions.en: Restart once; if repeated, service (official pattern).
solutions.ur: Ek baar restart karein; agar baar baar aaye to official hal se service karwayein.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage before condemning the board.
solutions.ur: Board ko kharab kehne se pehle mains voltage check karein.

notes.ur: Sirf title ke level se; description/transcript haasil nahi hue.
